overall_explanation: The lookup change preserves natural-order validation for unbounded empty maps, preserves comparator-backed empty-map no-comparison behavior, and lets bounds or nonempty tree descent perform the necessary query validation without an unconditional self-comparison. Bounded, descending, key-view, lazy-value, and entry-resolution paths continue to bind to the same findSlot implementation, with no public API or storage-layout change. No actionable defect is evident in the production change or its supporting metadata.
